arabic text: KOHRAAM MACH GAYA
english translation text: CHAOS ERUPTED!

arabic text: KHAIME MAY AAKE SHAH NE JAB ALWIDA KAHA\nKOHRAAM MACH GAYA
english translation text: WHEN HUSSAIN (A.S.) CAME INTO THE\nTENT AND SAID GOODBYE, CHAOS ERUPTED!

arabic text: THA JISKA INTEZAR WO SA'ATH QAREEB HAI\nDIN DHAL RAHA HAI SHAME MUSIBAT QAREEB HAI
english translation text: THE HOUR AWAITED BY THE AHLE BAYT IS NEAR, AS\nTHE DAY DRAWS TO A CLOSE, TRIBULATIONS ARE NEAR

arabic text: KUCH DAYR KI HAI BAAT QAYAMAT QAREEB HAI\nZAINAB GHAREEB BHAI KI RUKSAT QAREEB HAI
english translation text: IT’S JUST A SHORT WHILE AWAY, RECKONING IS\nNEAR. POOR EXILED ZAINAB, HER BROTHER'S DEPARTURE IS NEAR

arabic text: YE KEH KE MAANGA MAA KA JO KURTA SILA HUA\nKOHRAAM MACH GAYA...
english translation text: WHEN HE ASKED ZAINAB (SA) FOR THE SHIRT HIS\nMOTHER (SA) HAD MADE FOR HIS MARTYRDOM, CHAOS ERUPTED

arabic text: ZEHMAT NA HO BAAZU BADHAO BEHAN\nKUCH DOOR HATKE QAIME MAY BOLE SHAHE ZAMAN
english translation text: THE KING-OF-THE-TIME ASKED ZAINAB (SA), 'IF IT'S NOT\nTOO MUCH TROUBLE, CAN YOU EXTEND YOUR ARMS?'

arabic text: MAI BOSAY LOO WAHA KE BANDHEGI JAHAN RASAN\nBAAZU BADHA KE ROTI THI HAMSHEER KHASTATAN
english translation text: SO I CAN KISS THE PLACES WHERE ROPES WILL BE TIED, THE\nSISTER OF THE HUNGRY & THIRSTY CRIED WHILE EXTENDING HER ARMS

arabic text: BHAI BEHAN KE BAAZU KO JAB CHOOMNE LAGA\nKOHRAAM MACH GAYA...
english translation text: WHEN HUSSAIN (AS) STARTED KISSING THE\nARMS OF ZAINAB (SA), CHAOS ERUPTED!

arabic text: YE SUNKE BINTE FATEMA ZEHRA TADAP GAYI\nBOLI GALA BADHAO BAS JALD AB YA AQI
english translation text: THE DAUGHTER OF FATIMA (SA) QUIVERED WHEN SHE HEARD THE\nGOODBYE, SHE SAID ‘HUSSAIN (AS) EXTEND YOUR NECK, OH BROTHER’

arabic text: AMMA KI BAAT AAJ MUJHE YAAD AAGAYI\nMAI BOSAY LOO WAHAN KE CHALEGI JAHAN CHURI
english translation text: I JUST REMEMBERED A QUOTE FROM OUR MOTHER (SA), ‘LET\nME KISS THE PLACES WHERE THE KNIFE WILL STRIKE’

arabic text: ZAINAB NE BADKE CHOOMA BARADAR KA JAB GALA\nKOHRAAM MACH GAYA...
english translation text: WHEN ZAINAB (SA) KISSED THE NECK\nOF HER BROTHER (AS), CHAOS ERUPTED!

arabic text: BETI SE PHIR YE KEHNE LAGA FATEMA KA LAAL\nREHNA PHUPI KE PAAS RAKHENGI TERA KHAYAL
english translation text: THE SON OF FATIMA (AS) STARTED TALKING TO HIS DAUGHTER (SA),\nSTAY WITH YOUR AUNT, SHE WILL TAKE CARE OF YOU NOW

arabic text: GHURBAT HAI TUM PHUPI SE NA KARNA KOI SAWAAL\nWARNA TERE PADAR KO BAHOT HOYEGA MALAAL
english translation text: HARDSHIPS ARE UPON US, PLEASE DON'T GIVE HER\nA HARD TIME. OTHERWISE YOUR FATHER WILL BE SADDENED.

arabic text: PHIR SAR PE HAATH RAKH KE JO DENE LAGAY DUA\nKOHRAAM MACH GAYA...
english translation text: THEN WHEN HE PLACED HIS HAND ON HIS\nDAUGHTER'S HAND AND GAVE HER BEST WISHES, CHAOS ERUPTED!

arabic text: BETI KO JAB SUPURDE BEHAN KAR CHUKE IMAM\nROKAR BEHAN SE KEHNE LAGAY AASMAN MAQAM
english translation text: WHEN THE IMAM ENTRUSTED HIS SISTER WITH HIS DAUGHTER,\nCRYING, HE SAID TO HIS SISTER

arabic text: JAANA WATAN JO QAID SE CHUTKAR AY TISHNAQAM\nKEHNA LEHAD PE MAA KI MERA AAKHRI SALAM
english translation text: WHEN YOU RETURN HOME FROM IMPRISONMENT,\nGIVE MOTHER MY FINAL SALAAM

arabic text: AAYA JO LAB PE FATEMA ZEHRA KA TASKIRA\nKOHRAAM MACH GAYA...
english translation text: WHEN THE MENTION OF FATIMA\nZEHRA CAME OUT, CHAOS ERUPTED!

arabic text: ABID SE PHIR YE KEHNE LAGAY SHAHE KARBALA\nBEWAON KA AUR YATEEMO KA AB TUM HO AASRA
english translation text: SHAH-E-KARBALA SAID TO THE 4TH IMAM ‘YOU’RE NOW\nTHE SUPPORT OF THE WIDOWED AND ORPHANED’

arabic text: JO IMTEHAN MERA THA SAB MAINE DEDIYA\nAAGAY TERA JIHAD HAI BEMAARE KARBALA
english translation text: I’VE GIVEN ALL THE TESTS MEANT FOR ME,\nNOW IT WILL BE YOUR STRUGGLE.

arabic text: BEMAAR BETA BAAP SE JIS DAM JUDA HUA\nKOHRAAM MACH GAYA...
english translation text: THE MOMENT THE ILL SON SEPARATED\nFROM HIS FATHER, CHAOS ERUPTED!

arabic text: QAIME SE BAAHAR AAYE JO SULTANE KARBALA\nSAR KO JHUKAYE HUE ROTA THA KHUD ASPE BAWAFA
english translation text: WHEN THE KING OF KARBALA CAME OUT OF THE TENT,\nWITH HIS HEAD DOWN, GOD'S DEVOTEE USED TO CRY ALONE

arabic text: AB KIS TARHA SAWAAR HO ZEHRA KA LAADLA\nTANHAI KE SIWA KOI YAWAR NAHI BACHA
english translation text: HOW CAN FATIMA'S (SA) SON MOUNT THE HORSE\nALONE? HE HAS NO ASSISTANTS LEFT EXCEPT SOLITUDE!

arabic text: JAB SUYE NEHR DEKH KE GHAZI KO DI SADA\nKOHRAAM MACH GAYA...
english translation text: WHEN HE LOOKED TOWARDS THE RIVER (EUPHRATES) AND\nCRIED OUT FOR ABBAS (AS), CHAOS ERUPTED!

arabic text: BHAI KO TANHA DEKH KE ZAINAB TADAP GAYI\nROTI HUI HUSSAIN KE NAZDEEK AA GAYI
english translation text: ZAINAB BECAME RESTLESS SEEING HER LONESOME\nBROTHER. CRYING, SHE CAME CLOSE TO HUSSAIN.

arabic text: AUR PHIR RAQAAB THAAM KE BOLI AY SHAHE DEEN\nLO MAI SAWAAR KARTI HOO ABBAS GAR NAHI
english translation text: HOLDING THE HORSES STIRRUPS, SHE SAID\n‘I WILL HELP YOU UP IF ABBAS ISN’T HERE’

arabic text: WAYIZ HUA SAWAAR JO ZEHRA KA LAADLA\nKOHRAAM MACH GAYA...
english translation text: WHEN ZAHRA'S BELOVED SON MOUNTED HIS HORSE\nA GREAT COMMOTION AROSE...
